title: pinus pinaster subsp. acutisquama
intro: Pinus pinaster subsp. acutisquama, commonly known as Maritime Pine, is a subspecies of evergreen coniferous tree native to the Mediterranean coastal regions. The Maritime Pine has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and skin conditions, due to its rich content of bioactive compounds that have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the Maritime Pine include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
